evals.name: next-up-top5
evals.prompt: Check the tasker YouTrack board and tell me what I should work on next, top 5 by priority. DRY RUN: don't create Panes, worktrees or branches and don't change YouTrack; assume I pick #1 and show me exactly what to run to start it.
evals.expected_output: A ranked table from the live board (features first), notes on stale/blocked items (ts-12 looks done and blocks ts-13), and for rank 1 (ts-10) the command /yi-sdlc:implement-feature ts-10 medium for the operator to run, which opens its own Pane.
assertions: Ranks ts-10 (agent-sessions) as #1
Does not offer blocked features (ts-11, ts-13, ts-14, ts-15, ts-16) as startable
Flags ts-12 as done but still open on the board
Gives the command /yi-sdlc:implement-feature ts-10 medium (the installed command name) for the operator to run
Gives no runpane panes create command of its own
Created no Pane, branch or worktree and changed no ticket

evals.name: start-ts10-medium
evals.prompt: Start ts-10 with implement-feature at medium depth. DRY RUN: don't create anything or touch YouTrack, just print what you'd run.
evals.expected_output: Confirms ts-10 is ready and prints /yi-sdlc:implement-feature ts-10 medium for the operator to run in the main clone, saying it opens the feature's own Pane and gates tab and that agent-sessions is the name to give when it asks.
assertions: Prints the command /yi-sdlc:implement-feature ts-10 medium
Says the command opens the feature's own Pane (process-tickets doesn't create it)
Suggests agent-sessions as the feature name to give
Gives no runpane panes create command of its own
Created no Pane, branch or worktree and changed no ticket

evals.name: blocked-ts13
evals.prompt: Kick off ts-13 (the yi-sdlc flow panel) in its own Pane. DRY RUN: don't create anything or change the board.
evals.expected_output: Declines to start ts-13 because ts-10 is open; notes ts-12 is open on the board but looks done (all subtasks resolved), and suggests what to start instead.
assertions: Does not start (or green-light starting) ts-13
Names ts-10 as an open blocker of ts-13
Identifies ts-12 as done but still open on the board
Suggests starting ts-10 instead (or as the unblocking step)
Created no Pane, branch or worktree and changed no ticket

evals.name: pane-not-running
evals.prompt: Pane isn't open right now (I closed it). What's next on the tasker board? DRY RUN: don't create anything or change the board.
evals.expected_output: board.py launches the installed Pane app and waits for it; the report says Pane was started, ranks from the live Pane state (details-panel's Pane is found, so ts-12 is not treated as fresh), lists existing Panes' agent tabs as stopped and offers runpane panels resume without running it.
assertions: Runs board.py without --no-start-pane, so Pane is launched
Says in the report that Pane was started by this run
Ranking reflects existing Panes (no warning that Pane state is missing)
Lists the existing Panes' agents as stopped and offers to resume them without resuming any
Created no Pane, branch or worktree and changed no ticket

evals.name: named-feature-prints-command
evals.prompt: Start ts-10. Answer Cancel to any confirmation question.
evals.expected_output: Confirms ts-10 is ready; since a feature isn't started here, it asks no confirmation and prints /yi-sdlc:implement-feature ts-10 medium for the operator to run, with nothing created.
assertions: Asks no confirmation question for the feature pick
Prints the command /yi-sdlc:implement-feature ts-10 medium
Created no Pane, branch or worktree and changed no ticket

evals.name: auto-picks-top
evals.expected_output: No pick or confirmation question; takes the top 2 non-colliding candidates in rank order (ts-10 first), prints one 'Picked 2 tickets: ...' line, then the implement-feature commands (and the task tab call, if a task is picked); offers the ts-12 board move without making it.
assertions: Asks no pick or confirmation question
Picks at most 2 candidates, in rank order, with ts-10 first
Prints a line with the count and the picks before the commands
Does not move ts-12 on the board (a board move still needs the operator)
Created no Pane, branch or worktree and changed no ticket
